source_files.content: # Renders a status badge for a user-supplied label. module Badge def self.render(label) "#{label}" end end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'badge'

class BadgeTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_renders_label
    assert_includes Badge.render('ok'), 'ok'
  end
end
